signal: Trovata raised a $9M round co-led by State Street and PNC, acquired the ATOM treasury system, and launched Trovata AI 2.0.

email.body1:
Christopher, saw Trovata raised from State Street and PNC, acquired ATOM, and shipped Trovata AI 2.0.

A bigger platform usually means more in-market enterprises in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trovata off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christopher, quick follow-up for Trovata.

With ATOM folded in and AI 2.0 live, the addressable base just grew and pipeline expectations tend to outrun headcount. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Trovata needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Christopher, last bit of proof for Trovata.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trovata's reply rate likely compares to peer fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Christopher, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition and launching AI 2.0 is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Trovata either way.
